# Statistical Significance of GPS Special Message Anomalies

## Setup

| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Database | `data/messages.duckdb` |
| Unique messages | 3,994 |
| Null hypothesis alphabet | 45 symbols (GPS ICD IS-GPS-200 character set) |
| Observed distinct byte values | 47 (2 non-GPS: 0x00, 0xAA) |
| PPM-D model order | 8 |
| Random baseline | 100 repeats of 3994 random 22-byte messages (seed 42) |

## Test 1: Shared Substring Birthday Problem

**H0:** Messages are independent random draws from a 45-symbol alphabet.
Shared substrings of length L arise only by chance.

| 8 | 1.07e-04 | 4 | < 10^-100 | \*\*\* |
| 9 | 2.07e-06 | 4 | < 10^-100 | \*\*\* |

## Test 2: TEXT Prefix Frequency

**H0:** Messages are random draws from A^22 (A = 45).
The probability of any specific 4-byte prefix is 1/A^4.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| P(specific 4-byte prefix) | 1/45^4 = 2.44e-07 |
| Expected under H0 | lambda = N * p = 0.000974 |
| Observed TEXT-prefixed | 26 |
| **p-value** | **1.11e-16** |

### PRN concentration

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Most concentrated PRN | PRN 21 (11/38 unique PRN-message pairs) |
| P(>= 11 on one PRN \| Binomial(38, 1/32)) | **1.53e-08** |

## Test 3: TEXT Message Entropy Ranking

**H0:** TEXT messages are drawn from the same PPM-D entropy distribution as all messages.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Corpus mean entropy | 131.51 bits |
| TEXT messages below mean | 26 of 26 (100%) |
| Fraction of corpus below mean | 0.4815 |
| P(all 26 below mean) | **0.4815^26 = 5.58e-09** |

### Wilcoxon rank-sum test

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| z-statistic | -8.2260 |
| **p-value** | **< 10^-100** |
| TEXT mean | 122.24 bits (5.56 bits/byte) |
| Non-TEXT mean | 131.57 bits (5.98 bits/byte) |

## Test 4: Sentinel (All-Same-Byte) Message Probability

**H0:** Messages are random draws from A^22 (A = 45).
P(all-same-byte) = A * (1/A)^22 = A^-21.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| P(all-same-byte in 22 positions) | 45^-21 = 1.92e-35 |
| Expected under H0 | lambda = 7.66e-32 |
| Observed sentinels | 3 |
| **p-value** | **< 10^-100** |

The three sentinel messages:

| Byte | Observations | First seen | Last seen |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0xAA | 6,339 | 2010-02-14 | 2020-07-22 |
| 0x00 | 2,318 | 2010-03-14 | 2018-08-20 |
| 0x20 | 550 | 2009-09-21 | 2009-09-26 |

Lambda is effectively zero. Even 1 sentinel is astronomically unlikely under the random null hypothesis.

## Test 5: KS Test — GPS vs Random Baseline Entropy Distribution

**H0:** GPS message PPM-D entropy distribution is identical to random baseline.

The random baseline is generated by simulating 100 independent corpora of 3994 messages each (399400 total), drawing uniformly from the 45-symbol GPS ICD alphabet, and computing PPM-D order-8 leave-one-out scores.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| GPS sample | n = 3,994 |
| Random sample | n = 399,400 |
| KS statistic D | 0.059492 |
| **p-value** | **1.25e-12** |

### Effect size

| | GPS | Random |
|---|---|---|
| Mean | 131.51 bits | 131.99 bits |
| SD | 7.56 bits | 3.81 bits |

| Cohen's d | -0.0803 | **negligible** |

## Test 7: TEXT Payload Randomness

**H0:** The 18-byte payloads of TEXT messages (bytes 5-22) are independent
random draws from the 45-symbol GPS ICD alphabet.

TEXT messages: 26, payload length: 18 bytes each

### Test 7a: KS test on PPM-D payload entropy

Build a PPM-D order-8 model on the 26 payloads alone,
score each via leave-one-out, and compare to a random 18-byte baseline.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| TEXT payload scores | n = 26, mean = 111.34 bits, SD = 3.82 bits |
| Random 18-byte scores | n = 2,600, mean = 110.77 bits, SD = 3.91 bits |
| KS statistic D | 0.1388 |
| **p-value** | **6.71e-01** |
| Cohen's d | 0.1484 (negligible) |

### Test 7b: Chi-squared goodness-of-fit on payload bytes

Pool all 26 x 18 = 468 payload bytes and test uniformity
across the 45 GPS ICD symbols.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Total payload bytes | 468 |
| GPS ICD symbols | 45 |
| Expected per symbol | 10.40 |
| Chi-squared statistic | 35.65 (df = 44) |
| **p-value** | **8.11e-01** |

| 1 | Shared substrings (L=6) | 2.10e-11 | Yes |
| 1 | Shared substrings (L=9) | < 10^-100 | Yes |
| 2 | TEXT prefix frequency | 1.11e-16 | Yes |
| 2 | TEXT PRN concentration | 1.53e-08 | Yes |
| 3 | TEXT entropy ranking (binomial) | 5.58e-09 | Yes |
| 3 | TEXT entropy ranking (Wilcoxon) | < 10^-100 | Yes |
| 4 | Sentinel messages | < 10^-100 | Yes |

| 7a | TEXT payload KS (PPM-D) | 6.71e-01 | No |
| 7b | TEXT payload chi-squared GOF | 8.11e-01 | No |

All p-values are computed under the null hypothesis that GPS special messages
are independent random draws from the 45-symbol GPS ICD alphabet (IS-GPS-200).
